desc: 柔粉杂志式详情页：蝴蝶结尖头浅口鞋，多色俯铺、选码信息屏与做工微距
leaf: 女款尖头蝴蝶结浅口平底单鞋
name: 尖头蝴蝶结浅口平底单鞋款

shots.intent: 开放首屏：干净的成双白底主图先赢搜索点击，把尖头浅口轮廓交代清楚且无任何平台违规元素。
一秒主张屏：人鞋互动加缎带道具在柔粉场域里立住款式调性，同时留出一条可替换文案位。
shots.textZone: 左侧三分留白：主标题 + 一条副标签 + 一枚 #1A1A1A chip 标签

shots.intent: 自我代入：下半身实景让买家看到浅口鞋上脚后的脚背与鞋口线条，直接对照自己的通勤穿搭。
让买家一次挑完颜色：同光同尺度的俯铺成双排布把可选配色与鞋头朝向差异摊开，减少来回翻图。
shots.textZone: 每双鞋正下方一枚 #1A1A1A chip 标签

shots.intent: 证明工艺：高角度微距摊开鞋头弧线与结饰系法，把楦型宽松好穿的主张换成可见证据。
shots.textZone: 右下角：一条标签配 hairline 细引线指向鞋头

shots.intent: 回应磨脚疑虑：从后跟斜上方看进浅口鞋口，把包边高度、内里与垫脚边缘拍清楚。
shots.textZone: 左上：一枚灰色细刻度加一条标签

shots.intent: 去掉选码决策成本：把源图的键位参数行与选码查询网格改成结构可复用的信息屏，数值全部留白待回填。
shots.textZone: 右上四行 chip 键值清单 + 下方 hairline 空白表格 + 一条 measurement 提示标签

shots.intent: 收口去风险：用走线包边、成双对称与内里三个可见证据格代替证书声明，让质量可查而非可吹。
shots.textZone: 每格下方一条标签 + 底部一行收口主张

style.backgroundSystem: flat matte #F9EAE7 and #FFFFFF fields with one #E7E2DE secondary panel, plus a very low-contrast oversized outlined display-letter band used as texture only with no readable words; never photographic scenery or random environments
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line drawings, hairline measurement arrows and small grey tick marks above section labels only; no 3D, no gradients, no filled pictograms, no badge artwork
style.lightingSystem: soft warm diffused studio light from the upper right at 5300K with a wrap-around fill card, low-contrast soft contact shadows, no hard edges, one single light logic in every screen
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium feminine footwear detail-page ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean #FFFFFF, pale rose-neutral field #F9EAE7 and soft greige #E7E2DE as base fields, dusty rose #D49A90 as the single headline accent, #1A1A1A as the only chip-bar fill and deep charcoal #2D2D2D as the only ink color; warm neutral tone at 5300K; modern geometric sans-serif for both Chinese and Latin copy, one headline plus one or two short labels per screen, no serif or handwritten faces; background system of flat matte #F9EAE7 and #FFFFFF fields with one very low-contrast oversized outlined display-letter band treated as texture only and carrying no readable words, never random scenery or photographic environments; lighting system of soft warm diffused studio light from the upper right with a wrap-around fill, low-contrast soft contact shadows and no hard edges; surface system of seamless matte paper ground and lightly creased pale cloth #F2EAE6 on macro screens; layout system of hairline rules flanking each section headline, small grey tick marks above labels, #1A1A1A chip keys with reversed type for spec rows and generous margins; icon system of thin single-weight line drawings, hairline measurement arrows and grey tick marks only, no 3D, no gradients, no filled pictograms; product presentation rules: true proportions, stable slight 3/4 or clean 90-degree side geometry, consistent scale and centering across all screens, pointed toe line never warped, both shoes grounded by a visible soft contact shadow; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: true proportions and stable geometry: slight 3/4 front or clean 90-degree side, identical scale and centering across screens, pointed toe line never warped, both shoes always grounded by a visible soft contact shadow
style.surfaceSystem: seamless matte paper ground in #FFFFFF and #F9EAE7, lightly creased pale cloth #F2EAE6 on macro screens, hairline ground line under spec screens
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif for both Chinese and Latin copy; section headline in dusty rose #D49A90 flanked by hairline rules, body and labels in deep charcoal #2D2D2D, spec keys set as #1A1A1A chip bars with reversed type; headline 26-32pt, label 11-14pt, Chinese copy wrapped in corner brackets
